note: ADR 1023: a member call on a closed const object literal dispatches to the method written there, whatever its asserted type (`(t as unknown as Promise<void>).then(cb)` with `const t = { then(f) { f(); } }`): REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE at each write and STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at the read run in place are covered by violations (uncertifiable, function-run-unplaced, before); the two methods that hand the callback to a microtask are quiet and clean
